commercial_report_blocks.opening_essence: The Security Mirror points to a relationship mirror around this theme: The other person activates your deepest issues around safety and security. This is not a prediction about who you will attract; it is a symbolic reflection of what connection may help you see more clearly within yourself.
commercial_report_blocks.how_this_may_show_up: You may notice this mirror through a recurring loop such as: Swinging between fear of abandonment and fear of closeness. The same pattern may repeat in different forms until the deeper need, fear, boundary, or projection becomes visible.
commercial_report_blocks.core_gift: The gift of this mirror is the chance to build a more conscious relationship with yourself while you relate to others. The core lesson is: Build safety from within yourself, not from the relationship.
commercial_report_blocks.growth_edge: The growth edge is to slow down before making the other person the whole explanation. When something is activated, ask what the relationship is reflecting, what belongs to you, and what still needs honest communication or boundary repair.
commercial_report_blocks.integration_key: Integration begins through: Inner-child repair and boundary practice. This keeps the mirror grounded in self-responsibility rather than blame, fantasy, or relationship destiny.
commercial_report_blocks.one_week_practice: For one week, choose one relational trigger or recurring pattern. Write three lines: what happened, what it activated in me, and what response would keep me connected to myself without controlling the other person.
commercial_report_blocks.wisewave_reflection: You are not lacking safety. You are finding your strength again.
